title: BBC Design Replica
description: Recreated a BBC-inspired visual design as a practice project to develop accuracy in layout, typography, spacing and visual hierarchy.
objective: Practice reproducing a reference design accurately while improving layout, typography, spacing and attention to detail.
steps: Studied the reference design and identified its visual structure.
Recreated the main layout and visual elements.
Refined the composition to improve visual consistency and accuracy.
results: Created a portfolio practice recreation demonstrating layout accuracy, typography, visual hierarchy and attention to detail.
